title: Implement Framer Motion Animated Storefront with Full-Image Carousel, Staggered Category Grid, and Designer Canvas Containers
description: Per user explicit instruction, refactored `app/page.tsx` into a fluid, high-end Framer Motion animated storefront. Stripped out heavy text blocks and replaced them with dedicated, empty spatial containers (dashed borders) where designers can drop in final PNG assets, typography, and visual flourishes. Features: 1. Full-Image PNG Hero Carousel powered by AnimatePresence with crossfade & subtle scale (initial: { opacity: 0, scale: 1.05 }, animate: { opacity: 1, scale: 1 }, exit: { opacity: 0 }), auto-playing every 5s with pause on hover, manual indicator dots (carousel-dot-[index]), and prev/next controls; 2. 6 Core Service Verticals Staggered Grid with whileInView viewport trigger, Section Title Graphic spatial dashed container, and 6 responsive aspect-[4/5] cards with hover scale for Retail Framing (B2C), Bespoke Framing (B2C/B2B), Spatial Signage (B2B), Industrial CNC (Commercial), Custom Gifting (Corporate), and Civic Projects (Public Sector); 3. Featured Product & Capability Highlight with 2-column layout featuring an aspect-square drop zone on the left, and clean dashed containers on the right for Title Graphic (h-12), Details Graphic (h-32), and CTA Button (h-12 w-44 rounded-full in muted gold); 4. Maintained SiteHeader with sticky navigation, mega-menu, theme toggle, and SiteFooter with certifications; 5. Seamless compatibility with Museum Dark Mode and Warm Museum Light Mode; 6. Zero horizontal page overflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Refactored app/page.tsx as 'use client' using Framer Motion (motion, AnimatePresence)
Defined fadeUp and staggerContainer animation variants

Section 1: Full-Image PNG Hero Carousel powered by AnimatePresence mode='wait', crossfade & subtle scale, auto-playing every 5s with pause on hover, manual indicator dots (carousel-dot-[index]), and dashed canvas container

Section 2: 6 Core Service Verticals Staggered Grid with whileInView viewport trigger, Section Title Graphic dashed container, and 6 responsive aspect-[4/5] cards (data-testid='service-vertical-card-[id]') with hover scale
Section 3: Featured Product & Capability Highlight with 2-column layout (left aspect-square dropzone, right h-12 title container, h-32 details container, h-12 w-44 gold CTA button container)
Maintained SiteHeader and SiteFooter with sticky navigation, mega-menu, theme toggle, and certifications
Seamless compatibility with both Museum Dark Mode and Warm Museum Light Mode
Zero horizontal overflow across mobile viewports (scrollWidth <= clientWidth)
All Playwright automated tests pass (35/35) with 0 failures
Next.js production build succeeds with 0 errors
Visual proof screenshots captured for Desktop Dark, Desktop Light, and Mobile viewports in .agent/screenshots/ and brain directories
